name: servicenow-xml
description: Colorize and lint embedded ServiceNow scripts in exported XML; kind-aware XML structure validation; optional Records navigator.

commands.title: ServiceNow XML: Edit Embedded Script or JSON…
ServiceNow XML: Load Draft for Embedded Script…
ServiceNow XML: Manage Embedded Script Drafts…
ServiceNow XML: Prune redundant DELETE files…

servicenowXml.records.contents:
Enable the navigator to browse ServiceNow records by name.
[Enable Records Navigator](command:servicenowXml.navigator.enable)

Records are indexed from XML files in the workspace. This window has no folder open, so there is nothing to index — open the folder containing your exports to browse records.

Diagnostics and the document kind still work on the open file.

view/item/context.when: view == servicenowXml.records && servicenowXml.hasSnc && (viewItem == servicenowXml.record.delete || viewItem == servicenowXml.table.hasDelete)

servicenowXml.enable.description: Enable ServiceNow XML validation and JS linting once a gate passes (app workspace marker, an export-shaped document, or enabledForAllWindows).

servicenowXml.enabledForAllWindows.description: Bypass the ServiceNow app workspace gate so diagnostics run for every XML file in the window, not just export-shaped ones, and the Records view stays visible. Single export files already lint without this.

servicenowXml.formatJavaScript.description: After XML format, format JavaScript in script-typed XML fields (including scripts nested in update-set payloads). Uses the editor's JavaScript formatter.

servicenowXml.formatJson.description: After XML format, format JSON in JSON-typed XML fields such as output_schema, props and composition (including those nested in update-set payloads). Uses the editor's JSON formatter. Fields that do not parse as JSON are left alone.

servicenowXml.formatXmlFirst.description: When this extension is the XML default formatter, run the next XML formatter before formatting embedded scripts.

servicenowXml.lintJavaScript.description: Lint embedded JavaScript in script CDATA regions.

servicenowXml.lintJson.description: Lint JSON embedded in known ServiceNow XML fields.

servicenowXml.ignoreGlobs.description: Glob patterns for XML paths to skip (validation, lint, declaration index, and navigator).

servicenowXml.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay (ms) before re-validating on edit.

servicenowXml.navigator.enable.description: Enable the ServiceNow Records navigator. No indexing runs until the view is opened or Go to Record is used.

servicenowXml.navigator.excludeDelete.description: Hide action=DELETE records from the navigator.

enumDescriptions: Most opened (open count; table order by sum of opens)
Recently opened (last open time; table order by most recent child)
Recently updated (file mtime; table order by newest child)
sys_mod_count (ServiceNow update count; table order by max child)
Alphabetical by table then display name
servicenowXml.navigator.sortBy.description: Sort order for Records navigator tables and records.

servicenowXml.mcp.enable.description: Register ServiceNow MCP servers and install agent helpers (rules + scripts). In Cursor this also registers the Cursor plugin adapter.

servicenowXml.mcp.registry.description: Register the servicenow-xml-registry MCP server (schema, scripting, JS performance, workspace discovery).

servicenowXml.mcp.instance.description: Register the servicenow-xml-instance MCP server (read-only snc queries). Also requires snc on PATH or servicenowXml.snc.path.

servicenowXml.mcp.remote.description: Register git-based remote MCP servers (servicenow-xml-docs and servicenow-xml-ui-examples via gitmcp.io).

servicenowXml.snc.path.description: ServiceNow CLI executable for pruning redundant DELETE exports and the instance MCP. Leave as snc when the CLI is on PATH.

servicenowXml.snc.mcpProfiles.description: Instance MCP allowlist of snc profile names for Cursor and VS Code. Empty means every snc profile is available. Non-empty restricts list_profiles, record_query, and record_get to those names. Does not affect the prune-redundant-DELETE UI.
